candidate.title: MeDIP-Seq/DIP-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina grouped schematic of methylated DNA extraction, fragmentation/denaturation, antibody capture and purification; the terminal sequencing interface is stated by the caption/catalogue but not drawn. The methylated-DNA route represents MeDIP-Seq and a 5mC-directed instance of DIP-Seq. Other modification-specific DIP-Seq assays in the cited paper clarify the family but do not add target workflows or branches. Shared schematic applicability does not assert identical complete implementations.
